description: This PHP class 'FormBuilder' constructs and manages form creation using Symfony components, including CSRF protection, translation, and templating extensions.

classes.name: FormBuilder
classes.description: A class that builds and configures Symfony-based forms with extensions for CSRF, validation, templating, and translation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes form builder with extensions, CSRF protection, translation, and validation setup.

methods.name: createBuilder
methods.description: Creates a named form builder with default options.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns the form factory instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns the templating engine used for rendering forms.
